statements.text: Admiral, you mentioned the use of machine learning and artificial intelligence tools in order to improve the targeting, if you will, of what your inspectors look at.
statements.context: Congressman Larsen questions a Coast Guard admiral during a House hearing on small passenger vessel safety.

statements.text: Artificial intelligence in my view is, for lack of a better term, I would say it is the mother of all technologies here when it comes to military operations.
statements.context: House Armed Services Committee hearing on the FY2023 National Defense Authorization Act, featuring an exchange between Rep. Rick Larsen and General Mark Milley, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

statements.text: Given the increasing volume of information available and necessary to make sense of the environment, it is imperative that we use AI to triage incoming data streams and maximize the effectiveness of our limited human processing and analytic resources.
statements.context: House Armed Services Committee hearing on the FY 2023 Department of the Navy budget request, where Rep. Larsen questions the Marine Corps on AI progress and Gen. Berger responds.
